module_summary: Sequential 8-bit signed shift-and-add multiplier: operands sign-extended at reset, then over 16 counted cycles the shifted multiplicand is accumulated into p when the multiplier bit is set, then rdy rises.

anchors.name: p
anchors.why: 16-bit product accumulator adding shifted multiplicand when multiplier[ctr] is 1.

anchors.name: ctr
anchors.why: Step counter selecting multiplier bit, gating accumulation and asserting rdy at 16.

anchors.name: rdy
anchors.why: Level completion flag set once ctr reaches 16, held until reset.

anchors.name: multiplicand
anchors.why: Sign-extended b, left-shifted each step and added into p.

anchors.name: multiplier
anchors.why: Sign-extended a; bit multiplier[ctr] gates each accumulate.

anchors.name: a
anchors.why: Operand captured into multiplier during reset.

anchors.name: b
anchors.why: Operand captured into multiplicand during reset.

groups.name: step_control
groups.description: Step counter sequencing 16 iterations and raising rdy.

groups.name: shift_add_datapath
groups.description: Operand registers, shifting multiplicand and product accumulator.
